```plato

//==
// # Elementary transforms
//
// The single-purpose building blocks — the atoms — of the transform surface: one
// named operation each, in the plane and in space. Every one of them converts to
// the general affine transform of its dimension, and that affine form is how they
// compose: the elementary families are NOT closed under composition (two
// translations compose to a translation, but a rotation and a scaling do not stay
// in either family). The `*About*` types apply their operation about `Center`
// rather than about the origin. The operations live in
// `transforms.library.plato`.

// A translation in the plane: every point is displaced by the same vector
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Translation_(geometry)).
type Translation2D
    implements IValue, IRigid2D
{
    Vector: Vector2D;
}
```
